application.name: edd App Template
application.description: Production-ready SaaS starter: authentication, role-based access, user management, a contact-message inbox, a multi-provider AI assistant, database administration and i18n in English, Spanish and Danish.
application.auth: Better Auth, with Clerk as an alternative provider

main.label: Dashboard
main.description: Overview: a time-aware greeting, user and contact-message statistics, and recent sign-ups.
main.descriptionEs: Overview: a time-aware greeting, user and contact-message statistics, and recent sign-ups.

main.label: Contact Messages
main.description: Inbox for messages sent from the public contact form, with a detail panel, read and unread states, replies and archiving.
main.descriptionEs: Inbox for messages sent from the public contact form, with a detail panel, read and unread states, replies and archiving.

main.label: Users
main.description: User management: a data table with search, advanced filters, column selection and export, plus create, edit and delete.
main.descriptionEs: User management: a data table with search, advanced filters, column selection and export, plus create, edit and delete.

main.label: Get Help
main.description: AI assistant for questions about the dashboard, its data and its settings.
main.descriptionEs: AI assistant for questions about the dashboard, its data and its settings.

secondary.label: Language & theme
secondary.description: Interface language (English, Spanish, Danish) and light, dark or system theme.
secondary.descriptionEs: Interface language (English, Spanish, Danish) and light, dark or system theme.

secondary.label: AI configuration
secondary.description: Active provider, model and parameters for the assistant, with a connection test.
secondary.descriptionEs: Active provider, model and parameters for the assistant, with a connection test.

secondary.label: Database
secondary.description: Database administration: migrations, connection profiles and audit. Super admin only.
secondary.descriptionEs: Database administration: migrations, connection profiles and audit. Super admin only.

/dashboard.title: Dashboard
features: Time-aware greeting addressed to the signed-in user
User statistics with a breakdown by role
Unread contact messages
Recent sign-ups

/dashboard/users.title: Users
features: Data table with search, advanced filters, column selection and export
Role and access badges, and the authentication provider per user
Create and edit through a side sheet
Delete behind a confirmation dialog naming the account; deleting your own account is blocked

/dashboard/contact-messages.title: Contact messages
features: Inbox of messages from the public contact form
Detail panel with the full message
Read, unread and archived states

/dashboard/help.title: AI Help
features: Chat with the assistant about the dashboard
Markdown answers that link to the relevant route
The conversation is kept between visits

/dashboard/settings/system.title: Language & theme
features: Language: English, Spanish or Danish, applied immediately
Theme: light, dark or follow the system

/dashboard/settings/ia_config.title: AI configuration
features: Active provider and model
Temperature, max tokens and other parameters
Connection test per provider

/dashboard/settings/dev_tools.title: Developer tools
features: Diagnostics for developers

/dashboard/settings/ai_logs.title: AI logs
features: Audit log of AI requests with provider, model and timing

/dashboard/settings/site_settings.title: Site settings
features: Branding
Social links

/dashboard/settings/database.title: Database administration
features: Migration status and history
Connection profiles
Audit of administrative actions
Requires the super admin role

whereToFind.settings: Settings are under /dashboard/settings — language and theme at /dashboard/settings/system.
whereToFind.ai: The AI provider and model are configured at /dashboard/settings/ia_config.
whereToFind.database: Database administration is at /dashboard/settings/database, for super admins only.

howTo.createUser: Go to /dashboard/users and use the New User button; a side sheet opens with the form.
howTo.deleteUser: Go to /dashboard/users, open the row actions and choose Delete. A dialog names the account first, and you cannot delete your own.
howTo.exportUsers: Go to /dashboard/users and use Export above the table.
howTo.changeLanguage: Go to /dashboard/settings/system and pick English, Spanish or Danish.
howTo.changeTheme: Go to /dashboard/settings/system and pick light, dark or system.
howTo.changeAiProvider: Go to /dashboard/settings/ia_config, pick the provider and model, and use the connection test.
howTo.readContactMessage: Go to /dashboard/contact-messages and select a message to open the detail panel.

dataOverview.users: Accounts with a role, an authentication provider and a join date.
dataOverview.contactMessages: Messages from the public contact form, each read or unread and optionally archived.
dataOverview.roles: Role-based access control; some sections require a specific role.

aiCapabilities.answers: Questions about the dashboard, its sections, its data and its settings.
aiCapabilities.navigation: Names the exact route for a section when one exists.
aiCapabilities.limits: Cannot change data. It explains where to do it and what the section offers.
